# NLP501-bench v2 results (generated by `python -m app.eval.benchmark_v2 report`; do not edit by hand)

v1 unchanged + 8 Djinni JDs (real anonymised CVs) in test. Manifest: data/eval/benchmark_v2.json (all inputs match). Djinni labels in use: **silver (mean of 2 LLM annotators; not human)**; metrics there are condensed (judged CVs only). Each JD ranks its source's pool; mean over JDs with a 95% bootstrap CI; paired one-sided bootstrap p for “first > second”. Đán core is not run on Djinni and is left out here (see the v1 report). LLM: Claude Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5; PYTHONHASHSEED=0.
